text:
Jordan: New format proposal  'Rapid-fire breakouts' for the June webinar. Short keynote + three 12-minute demo-forward rooms. want focused CTAs + A/B social tests.
Anya: sounds promising. tighter format should boost conversions. +1 on A/Bing creatives. :sparkles:
Sam: breakout suggestions: cost ops (batching/cache), private deploys (VPC/compliance), evals & alerts (regression detection). add tiny demo repo in follow-up.
Mira: agree. propose each breakout includes: 90s recorded demo clip for failover, 6m live demo, 3m customer use-case slide, 3m live Q. keeps live risk low.
Jordan: draft run-of-show (tight):
```
00:00 Welcome + goals (Jordan) 3m
03:00 Keynote: production patterns (Anya) 12m
15:00 Breakout intros (hosts quick 30s each) 2m
17:00 Breakouts A/B/C (12m each)
53:00 Regroup: lightning takeaways (3 speakers) 6m
59:00 Panel rapid Q&A (moderated) 10m
69:00 Close, CTAs, office hours sign-up (Lina/SDR) 6m
```
Kai: nice. a few infra asks: need a warmed KV cache in staging for live demos, ephemeral key rotation, and a short replay clip per breakout. I can provision endpoint and clips.
Anya: Speakers: keynote Anya, breakout A Sam, B Mira, C Jordan. please confirm rehearsal slots: Tues 8am PT (full run) and Thu 9am PT (tech check).
Sam: both work for me.
Mira: Tuesday OK, Thu OK.
Jordan: confirmed.
ops-bot: Rehearsal events created: 2025-06-10T15:00Z (full run) and 2025-06-12T16:00Z (tech check). Runbook uploaded to #marketing-resources.
Anya: Registration form/marketing asks: add dropdown for breakout choice, a 2-question micro-survey (use-case & priority), and an opt-in for office hours. We'll tag leads with 'breakout_choice' and 'use_case_score'.
Sam: Good. SDR routing plan: cost -> Sam, private -> Mira, evals -> Jordan. Lina will own office-hours signups.
Lina: I'll create the office-hours calendar and follow-up email templates. want a short calendar invite copy to include in post-webinar automation.
Jordan: CTA A/B ideas (short):
A1: "Cut token spend with smarter batching & cache"
A2: "Lower inference spend 2-4x with automated batching"
B1: "Run inference in your VPC with audit trails"
B2: "Private inference: compliance-ready in days"
C1: "Ship safer: detect regressions before customers"
C2: "Quality guardrails: automated evals & alerts"
Anya: we'll run A/B across two social creatives and two CTA variants per breakout. target lift measurement in GA + landing conversion.
Sam: follow-up assets: short playbook + sample prompts + repo link. I'll draft cost playbook v1.
Mira: private demo needs sanitized dataset + sample IAM policy. Jordan can you scrub logs and provide an obfuscated example?
Jordan: will scrub and push sanitized files to the shared drive by EOD tomorrow.
Kai: provisioning staging endpoint: `https://staging.redwood-demo/1765` with KV warmup script. ephemeral keys distributed at rehearsal. also adding a lightweight health-check HUD for speakers to monitor token latency.
Mira: appreciate the HUD. for private demo please include a note in runbook about not exposing PII and showing stubbed audit logs.
Anya: rehearsal tech checklist: slides in drive 48h before, headshots + 40-word bios by Fri, short prerecorded clips submitted 72h before, captioning/transcript enabled, captions QA.
Sam: captioning note: let's enable live captions and record transcript for QA snippets.
Jordan: add timezone fallback plan: record a 10-min highlight reel for APAC distribution and schedule a live office-hours session friendly to APAC. Lina can own scheduling.
Lina: will set up APAC office hours and booking links; also prepping SDR follow-up cadence (email + 2 touches via Linkedin + calendar invite).
Anya: contingency/failover rules for runbook: if live demo latencies > 1.5s token p95 for >30s, switch to pre-recorded 90s clip + speaker live commentary. infra to push a chat banner: "Playing short demo clip due to instability".
Jordan: add a manual fallback trigger and an ops-bot auto-detect rule. Kai to implement threshold.
Kai: adding health monitor and automatic clip switch. will test in rehearsal.
Sam: Q triage: each breakout has a moderator to collect top 3 questions; send to panel slack thread for live synthesis. moderators: Sam (A), Mira (B), Jordan (C). Anya will moderate main panel.
Mira: also recommend a 2-minute speaker warmup just before stage (mic check + 30s target message run) so speakers don't overrun.
Anya: landing page copy + two social variants per breakout assigned to me. I'll push drafts to the copy folder by Wed. A/B test matrix doc will live in the runbook.
Jordan: action items summary: 1) Jordan scrub dataset; 2) Kai provision staging + clips; 3) Speakers submit bios/headshots + clips; 4) Anya drafts landing + socials; 5) Lina sets office-hours and SDR cadence; 6) Sam drafts playbook. deadline: Fri COB.
ops-bot: Recording enabled. Post-event assets (video + transcript + clip snippets) will be saved to Marketing Drive under /webinars/2025-06-xx.
Anya: thanks team f680 let's keep momentum. I'll update the run-of-show doc with A/B matrix and ping when copy folder is live.
Jordan: will follow up after scrub complete.
Lina: I'll start the office-hours calendar and template work.
Kai: will run warmup script and health checks during rehearsals.
Sam: prepping playbook. see you all at rehearsals. :clap:
